title: Earliest track: demo-email-notifications-v2 to sixty per cent; hold demo-tax-calculation-v2
notes: demo-email-notifications-v2 adds prod-emea-central-04 and reaches sixty per cent of Production. demo-tax-calculation-v2 is deliberately restated at thirty rather than advanced, because the connection budget forces its evaluator to stop and an unobserved rollout produces a gap in the crossover rather than a curve.
Advancing a flag nobody is evaluating would spend the schedule without buying evidence. It resumes in September when the monthly connection allowance resets.

One archive candidate therefore keeps a complete observed journey through rollout, code removal, drain and silence. The other becomes the backup, still fully valid as a catalog entry and still archivable, just without a filmed rollout.
